planSteps.description: Navigate to the app root at http://localhost:5173/
Verify the NomNom start screen is visible with PUBLIC ARENA, PLAY AS GUEST (FREE), LOGIN WALLET, and SPECTATE controls
Enter QA Guest in the GUEST NICKNAME field
Verify the nickname field contains QA Guest
Click PLAY AS GUEST (FREE) and wait for the game view to become active
Verify the start menu closes and the in-game HUD displays player mass and the active arena canvas
